headline: IRFC gets GST demand of ₹549 crore dropped
summary: Indian Railway Finance Corporation received an order dropping a ₹549.32 crore GST demand. The Assistant Commissioner of State Tax, Delhi, passed the order on October 23, 2026.

headline: Arisinfra seeks shareholder nod for ₹550 crore RPT limits
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for material related party transactions with subsidiaries JS Infra Core and Buildmex-Infra, setting aggregate limits of ₹550 crore.

headline: Suditi Industries Q1FY27 Results: EBITDA margin hits 16%
summary: Suditi Industries reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹174 million, up 16% YoY. EBITDA margin expanded to 16.09%, driven by retail mix shift and Gini & Jony integration.

headline: Trent subsidiary to sell Netria to TreBits REIT
summary: Nahar Retail Trading Services, a Trent subsidiary, enters binding term sheet to divest 100% stake in Netria Property Holdings to TreBits Investment Trust for ₹171.91 crore plus equity consideration.

headline: Datakosa Q2FY27 Results: Revenue down 38% YoY
summary: Datakosa Limited reported a 38% YoY decline in operating income for Q2FY27. The company posted a net profit of ₹36.98 lakh, down from ₹42.16 lakh in the same period last year.

headline: Crompton Greaves CE receives consumer court order
summary: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals received an order from the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Hyderabad II, for refunds and compensation totaling ₹54,885 across two cases.

headline: Trualt Bioenergy Q2 revenue surges to 8.11B rupees
summary: Trualt Bioenergy reported Q2 revenue of 8.11B rupees, compared to 1.15B rupees in the same period last year, marking a sharp year-on-year rise.

headline: Suditi Industries gets BSE listing approval for shares
summary: Suditi Industries received BSE approval for 48 lakh equity shares issued via warrant conversion. Trading starts after NSE and depository confirmations.

headline: Kesar Petro Q2FY27 PAT falls 80% YoY
summary: Kesar Petroproducts reported a net profit of ₹1.20 lakh for Q2FY27, down 80% from ₹5.91 lakh in the year-ago quarter, as costs outpaced revenue growth.

headline: Sueryaa Knitwear board approves compliance certs
summary: Sueryaa Knitwear board approved non-applicability certificates for related party transactions and corporate governance for Q2FY27, citing small-scale exemptions.

headline: Setco Automotive posts ₹20,530 lakh Q1FY27 PAT
summary: Setco Automotive reported a standalone net profit of ₹20,530 lakh for Q1FY27, driven by a ₹21,428 lakh investment gain. The board also approved the merger of Lava Cast and overseas restructuring.

headline: Aris International seeks shareholder nod for share split, director appointments
summary: Aris International Limited has initiated a postal ballot for sub-dividing equity shares from ₹10 to ₹5 face value. The notice also seeks approval for two new independent directors and enhanced borrowing limits under Sections 186 and 185.

headline: Panache Q2 net profit jumps to ₹93M
summary: Panache reported Q2 consolidated net profit of ₹93 million, up from ₹14 million YoY. Revenue rose to ₹1.3 billion from ₹391 million in the same period last year.

headline: OFSS Q2 net profit rises to ₹7 billion
summary: Oracle Financial Services Software posted a consolidated net profit of ₹7 billion in Q2, up from ₹5.5 billion YoY. Revenue grew to ₹19.1 billion, beating the prior year's ₹17.9 billion.

headline: Juniper Hotels holds investor meet on Oct 23
summary: Juniper Hotels Limited conducted a physical Analyst & Investor Meeting on October 23, 2026. The session focused on sharing publicly available information with institutional investors and analysts.

headline: Themis Medicare seeks shareholder approval for director re-appointment
summary: Themis Medicare Limited has issued a postal ballot notice for the re-appointment of Bhaskar Vemban Iyer as Independent Director. E-voting opens October 24, 2026.

headline: Highway Company wins ₹340.08 crore NHAI order in Tamil Nadu
summary: Highway Company received a ₹340.08 crore acceptance letter from NHAI for the Palayam Fee Plaza project in Tamil Nadu.

headline: Shlokka Dyes CS resigns effective Oct 31
summary: Siddharth Parshotam Gajra resigned as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of Shlokka Dyes Ltd to pursue other professional opportunities.

headline: Oracle Financial Services Q2FY27 Net Profit Jumps 35% YoY
summary: Oracle Financial Services Software Ltd reported a 35% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹7,024 million for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew 6.6% YoY to ₹19,066 million.

headline: ISF Ltd exempt from RPT disclosures under SEBI norms
summary: ISF Ltd states Regulation 23 is not applicable as its paid-up capital and net worth fall below SEBI thresholds for FY26.

headline: Madhav Infra issues corrigendum to postal ballot notice
summary: Madhav Infra Projects Ltd issued a corrigendum to its October 14, 2026 postal ballot notice, clarifying that the preferential issue will be for consideration other than cash.

headline: GE Shipping buys secondhand VLGC
summary: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited contracted to buy a secondhand Very Large Gas Carrier of about 82,000 cbm. The 2015-built vessel joins the fleet in Q3FY27, financed via internal accruals.

headline: Doms Industries sets up new subsidiary
summary: Doms Industries Ltd incorporated DOMS Seven Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary for manufacturing premium bags and backpacks, investing ₹1 lakh.

headline: Nippon Life India AMC to host investor meet on Nov 5
summary: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd will participate in the Ashika Institutional Equities Investor Conference in Mumbai on November 5, 2026.

headline: City Pulse Q2FY27: Consolidated PAT jumps 2,272%
summary: City Pulse Multiventures Ltd reported a massive surge in consolidated net profit to ₹2,349.09 lakh for H1FY27, driven by subsidiary revenue growth.

headline: Milestone Furniture board meets Oct 23 for FY26 results
summary: Milestone Furniture Limited schedules a board meeting on October 23, 2026, to approve FY26 financial statements, appoint auditors, and consider OCD conversions.

headline: NCLT sanctions Network18-Marathi merger
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal has sanctioned the amalgamation of News18 Marathi Private Limited with Network18 Media & Investments Ltd.

headline: Zee Learn appoints Rakesh Chaturvedi as CFO and Director
summary: Zee Learn Ltd has appointed Rakesh Chaturvedi as Additional Director (Whole-time) and CFO effective November 9, 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

headline: Lemon Tree Hotels adds 63-room property in Bhilwara
summary: Lemon Tree Hotels signs license agreement for Keys Lite in Bhilwara, Rajasthan. The 63-room hotel strengthens the group's presence in key industrial hubs.

headline: REC Ltd sets up three power transmission subsidiaries
summary: REC Ltd incorporated three wholly owned subsidiaries for power transmission projects in Bikaner and Yeida, with a paid-up capital of ₹5 lakh each.

headline: Aeroflex subsidiary completes Stilonn acquisition
summary: Aeroflex Neu Limited, a material subsidiary of Aeroflex Enterprises, has completed the acquisition of a 51.01% stake in Stilonn Valves and Controls Private Limited.

headline: AP Tanneries appoints Deepak Uphale as independent director
summary: Andhra Pradesh Tanneries Limited appointed Deepak Uphale as an Additional Director (Non-Executive Independent Director) effective October 23, 2026, for a five-year term.

headline: Bank of Baroda appoints Hari Har Mishra as GOI director
summary: Bank of Baroda appoints Additional Secretary Hari Har Mishra as Government of India nominee director, replacing Ashish Madhaorao More effective October 23, 2026.

headline: Suraj Industries raises stake in VRV Foods to 20.41%
summary: Suraj Industries acquired 75,850 equity shares of VRV Foods for ₹50.06 lakh, increasing its holding to 20.41% of the associate company's paid-up capital.

headline: Tata Motors Q2FY27 earnings call recording live
summary: Tata Motors Limited has made the audio recording of its Q2FY27 earnings conference call available on its website, following SEBI regulations.

headline: ideaForge terminates US UAV joint venture with First Breach
summary: ideaForge Technology Ltd's subsidiary terminated its JV with First Breach Inc. due to deal closing failure. No capital was contributed, and all claims were mutually waived.

headline: Sobha Ltd faces ₹29.76 crore GST demand
summary: Sobha Ltd received a GST appeal order for ₹29.76 crore plus interest and penalty. The company plans to appeal to GSTAT, stating no operational impact.

headline: Raymond Realty gets BSE, NSE nod for warrant issue
summary: Raymond Realty Ltd received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for issuing 66.57 lakh convertible warrants to promoters at ₹614 per share.

headline: Transworld Shipping approves vessel acquisitions
summary: Transworld Shipping Lines members approved the acquisition of two container vessels, OEL Surya and OEL Varun, from Orient Express Lines Inc. via postal ballot with over 98% support.

headline: BPCL reschedules Q2FY27 earnings call to Oct 26
summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited has rescheduled its Q2FY27 post-results conference call to October 26, 2026, at 11:00 am. The change is due to business exigency.

headline: Shriram Finance uploads Q2FY27 earnings call audio
summary: Shriram Finance Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its Q2 FY27 earnings call held on October 23, 2026. The link is available on the company website, with the transcript to follow.
